items.name: Time To Grow Up
items.trigger: After being hit
items.effectSummary: Increases the duration of the speed boost after a hit.
items.cardSummary: Time To Grow Up is a simple chase safety perk for surviving the first hit. It helps when you need a little more post-hit distance before the killer can pressure again.
items.rawEffect: Increases the duration of the speed boost after being hit by 1/2/3 seconds.

items.name: Great Collapse
items.trigger: Stun the killer with a pallet
items.effectSummary: Rewards a pallet stun with a short speed burst, then applies Winded.
items.cardSummary: Great Collapse turns a good pallet stun into an escape window. It fits survivors who fight back at loops, but Winded keeps it from chaining into constant speed boosts.
items.rawEffect: Whenever you stun the killer using a pallet, gain 20/30/40% speed boost for 2/2/3 seconds. This perk does not activate whilst you have the winded status effect. Applies the winded status effect for 40 seconds after triggering.

items.name: Left Behind
items.trigger: Escape gates powered
items.levelValues: 5/6/7% speed boost until the round ends
items.effectSummary: Gives a permanent endgame speed boost once gates are powered.
items.cardSummary: Left Behind is built for the final escape stretch. It does nothing early, but it becomes useful when gates are powered and every second of distance matters.
items.rawEffect: When the escape gates are powered, gain a 5/6/7% speed boost until the end of the round.

items.name: Quick Recovery
items.trigger: Fast or medium vault a window
items.levelValues: 40% speed boost for 3 seconds; Winded 70/60/50 seconds
items.effectSummary: Adds a short speed burst after a window vault and then applies Winded.
items.cardSummary: Quick Recovery rewards clean window routing. It is strongest when the vault actually creates distance, because the Winded timer blocks another activation for a while.
items.rawEffect: Whenever you fast or medium vault a window, gain a 40% speed boost for 3 seconds. This perk does not activate whilst you have the winded status effect. This perk applies the winded status effect for 70/60/50 seconds after use.

items.name: Snake Step
items.trigger: While crouched
items.cooldownOrLimit: Aura block has a 45 second cooldown
items.effectSummary: Blocks killer aura reveal while crouched and greatly increases crouch speed.
items.cardSummary: Snake Step is a stealth perk for hiding from aura reads without crawling across the map. It helps patient survivors reposition while crouched instead of sprinting into chase.
items.rawEffect: While crouched, stop the killer from revealing your aura. This effect has a cooldown of 45 seconds. Additionally, this perk increases your crouching speed by 90/100/110%.

items.name: We're Stronger Together
items.trigger: Stay within 15 studs of another survivor
items.levelValues: 4/5/6% speed boost for survivors in range
items.effectSummary: Grants a small speed boost to nearby survivors when grouped.
items.cardSummary: We're Stronger Together is for team movement, rescues, and grouped pressure. It loses value when everyone splits up, but it helps a tight group move faster around danger.
items.rawEffect: Whenever you are within 15 studs of any survivor, every survivor within the range gains a 4/5/6% speed boost.

items.name: Against All Odds
items.trigger: Heal a survivor in dying state
items.effectSummary: Speeds up healing on downed survivors and reveals the killer aura.
items.cardSummary: Against All Odds is a rescue-focused healing perk. It is best when your team needs someone who can pick up downed survivors quickly while still tracking the killer.
items.rawEffect: Whilst healing a survivor in the dying state (downed), gain a 50/60/70% healing speed boost, and reveal the aura of the killer.

items.name: Ambitious Medic
items.trigger: Land a great skill check while injured
items.levelValues: 2 healing charges recovered; 40% more skill checks
items.cooldownOrLimit: Healing skill checks rotate 40% slower if both survivors use it
items.effectSummary: Rewards great healing skill checks with recovered progress and more frequent skill checks.
items.cardSummary: Ambitious Medic is for players comfortable with healing skill checks. It can recover progress, but it also changes the rhythm of healing when both survivors bring it.
items.rawEffect: Whenever you are injured, and land a great skill check, your healing progress will be recovered by 2 charges; this effect has a sound cue when triggered. This perk also increases your default skill check trigger chance by 40%. Additionally, healing skill checks will be 40% slower if both survivors are using this perk.

items.name: Enhanced Touch
items.trigger: Finish a heal action you started on another survivor
items.effectSummary: After a completed heal, gives the healed survivor better healing, repairing, and movement for a short time.
items.cardSummary: Enhanced Touch makes a completed heal create momentum. It fits support players who want the healed teammate to get back to objectives or reposition faster.
items.rawEffect: After a heal action on another survivor started by you finishes, the healed survivor gains a 10% boost to healing and repairing, plus a 5% boost to movement for 20/25/30 seconds.

items.name: Grab My Hand
items.trigger: After you unspike a survivor
items.effectSummary: Gives a large healing speed boost after rescuing a spiked survivor.
items.cardSummary: Grab My Hand turns an unspike into a fast reset window. It is useful when your team can rescue first and heal immediately after the killer leaves.
items.rawEffect: After you unspike a survivor, you gain a 75% healing speed boost for 45/60/75 seconds.

items.name: Nobody Left Behind
items.trigger: Escape gates powered
items.effectSummary: Reveals every survivor and improves healing and unspiking when gates are powered.
items.cardSummary: Nobody Left Behind is an endgame rescue perk. It helps find teammates and speed up saves when the exit phase turns chaotic.
items.rawEffect: When the gates are powered, reveal the aura of every survivor to you and gain a 55/65/75% boost to healing and unspiking.

items.name: Pacifist
items.trigger: Always active
items.levelValues: 20% base healing boost; +5/7/10% per missing survivor
items.effectSummary: Gives a permanent healing speed boost that grows when survivors are missing.
items.cardSummary: Pacifist is steady healing value with better late-round scaling. It fits players who want a simple support perk that does not need a special trigger.
items.rawEffect: Gain a permanent 20% healing speed boost. This is increased by an additional 5/7/10% per survivor missing from the normal 5 by any means.

items.name: Absolute Confidence
items.trigger: While you are in chase
items.cooldownOrLimit: Only helps while you are chased
items.effectSummary: When chased, nearby survivors gain action speed and have their aura revealed to you.
items.cardSummary: Absolute Confidence makes your chase useful for teammates. It is strongest when you can keep the killer busy while nearby survivors work objectives.
items.rawEffect: Whilst you are in a chase, survivors within 180 studs will gain a 3/5/7% action speed boost and have their aura revealed to you.

items.name: Call Me Back
items.trigger: A survivor you healed gets hit
items.effectSummary: Reveals a healed survivor after the killer hits them.
items.cardSummary: Call Me Back helps support players keep track of someone they recently healed. It is useful when a teammate gets pressured again before the team can fully reset.
items.rawEffect: When a survivor you healed gets hit by the killer, their aura will be revealed to you for 20/30/40 seconds.

items.name: Debut Showcase
items.trigger: Parry, stun, or blind the killer
items.effectSummary: Reveals the killer to every survivor after you interrupt them.
items.cardSummary: Debut Showcase turns a good defensive play into team information. It works best with survivors who already use parries, pallet stuns, or blinds well.
items.rawEffect: Whenever you parry, stun or blind the killer, the aura of the killer will be revealed to every survivor for 3/4/5 seconds.

items.name: Eyes of Heaven
items.trigger: Always active nearby
items.levelValues: Pallet and window aura range 80/90/100 studs
items.effectSummary: Reveals pallets and windows in a nearby radius.
items.cardSummary: Eyes of Heaven helps newer loopers find routes before panic sets in. It is a comfort pick for learning where pallets and windows are during a chase.
items.rawEffect: The aura of all pallets and windows are revealed to you within an 80/90/100 stud range.

items.name: Flawless Execution
items.trigger: Hit consecutive great skill checks while repairing alone
items.levelValues: 3/4/5% repair boost; extra +1/2/3% after third great check; 8/10/12s return window
items.effectSummary: Rewards solo generator great skill-check streaks with repair speed, but the streak ends on a miss.
items.cardSummary: Flawless Execution is for objective players who can hit great skill checks. It can speed up solo repairs, but mistakes reset the value.
items.rawEffect: While repairing a generator and hitting consecutive great skill checks alone, gain a 3/4/5% repair speed boost until you miss. After your third consecutive great skill check, this effect is increased by an additional 1/2/3%. Each skill check you hit decreases the duration of the next by 0.05/0.075/0.1 seconds until you miss. You have an 8/10/12 second window to return to your generator after leaving.

items.name: Heads Up
items.trigger: Killer gets within 50 studs
items.cooldownOrLimit: Does not activate while Winded; applies Winded for 40 seconds
items.statusEffect: Sound cue; killer aura reveal; speed boost; Winded
items.effectSummary: Warns you when the killer is close, reveals them, and gives a short speed boost.
items.cardSummary: Heads Up is an early-warning perk for avoiding surprise hits. It helps you leave an unsafe spot, but Winded stops it from repeating too often.
items.rawEffect: When the killer gets within a 50 stud range of you, receive a sound cue, reveal the aura of the killer, and gain a 10/15/20% speed boost for 3 seconds. This perk does not activate whilst you have the winded status effect. Applies the winded status effect for 40 after triggering.

items.name: Hearing Aid
items.trigger: Killer breaks a pallet or damages a generator within 240 studs
items.effectSummary: Reveals the killer after they break or damage an objective nearby.
items.cardSummary: Hearing Aid converts killer noise into information. It is useful when the killer is pressuring nearby loops or generators and you need to know where they moved.
items.rawEffect: Whenever the killer breaks a pallet or damages a generator within a 240 stud range, reveal the aura of the killer for 4/5/6 seconds.

items.name: Last Stand
items.trigger: Escape gates powered
items.statusEffect: Soul state heal; killer aura reveal
items.effectSummary: When gates are powered, heals a soul state and reveals the killer.
items.cardSummary: Last Stand is a late-round safety perk for the gate phase. It helps you recover and see the killer when the match is close to ending.
items.rawEffect: When the escape gates are powered, heal a soul state and reveal the aura of the killer for 10/15/20 seconds.

items.name: On My Own
items.trigger: You are the last survivor alive
items.statusEffect: Killer aura reveal; opening speed boost
items.effectSummary: As the last survivor, reveals the killer and speeds up opening for an escape attempt.
items.cardSummary: On My Own is a clutch perk for the final survivor. It has no value while the team is alive, but it can make the last escape attempt more realistic.
items.rawEffect: When you are the last survivor alive, reveal the aura of the killer for 10 seconds and gain a 40/50/60% opening speed boost.

items.name: Perfectionist Planning
items.trigger: Closest unrepaired generators revealed
items.levelValues: Aura reveal to others for 35/45/55 seconds
items.statusEffect: Generator aura reveal; repair speed change
items.effectSummary: Highlights the three closest unrepaired generators and rewards repairing them faster.
items.cardSummary: Perfectionist Planning points you toward a generator route. It is good for objective players, but it punishes ignoring the highlighted generators.
items.rawEffect: The aura of the 3 unrepaired generators closest are revealed to you. Repairing these generators allows you to repair them 10% faster, as well as revealing their aura to other survivors for 35/45/55 seconds. Repairing any other generator is 5% slower.

items.name: Visual Learner
items.trigger: Generators completed, then fast vault a window
items.cooldownOrLimit: Needs generator tokens and a fast vault
items.statusEffect: Extended aura duration; killer aura reveal
items.effectSummary: Improves aura visibility and spends generator-earned tokens on killer aura reveals after fast vaults.
items.cardSummary: Visual Learner is an information perk with a setup step. It rewards objective progress first, then gives chase information when you vault.
items.rawEffect: A perk that increases the duration in which auras are shown to you. Alongside that, gain tokens when generators are completed, using the tokens when you fast vault a window to reveal the aura of the killer to you.

items.name: Familiar Soul
items.trigger: Nearby survivors
items.effectSummary: Reveals nearby survivor auras so you can find teammates more easily.
items.cardSummary: Familiar Soul is simple team awareness. It helps support players find teammates for heals, rescues, or grouped objective pressure.
items.rawEffect: The aura of other survivors are revealed to you within an 80/90/100 stud range.

items.name: Built Different
items.trigger: Heal up from dying state
items.effectSummary: Grants Endurance after healing from dying state and allows one self-pickup per round.
items.cardSummary: Built Different is a recovery perk for surviving after a down. The one-time self-pickup makes it valuable, but timing still matters after you stand up.
items.rawEffect: Whenever you heal up from the dying state by any means, gain the endurance status effect for 6/7/8 seconds. Additionally allows you to pick yourself back up from the dying state once per round.

items.name: Desperate
items.trigger: After being picked up by the killer
items.effectSummary: Gives instant wiggle progress when the killer picks you up.
items.cardSummary: Desperate is for players who want a better chance to escape a carry. It is narrow, but the trigger matters when the killer is trying to spike you.
items.rawEffect: After being picked up by the killer, instantly gain 10/15/20% wiggle progression.

items.name: Flowstate
items.trigger: Fast window vault while active
items.effectSummary: Makes a fast window vault quicker with a special animation, then goes on cooldown.
items.cardSummary: Flowstate is a clean chase perk for window routes. It helps when one faster vault can deny a hit, but it needs a real window path to matter.
items.rawEffect: When you perform a fast window vault while this perk is active, you vault 20% quicker with a special animation. This perk has a cooldown of 70/60/50 seconds.

items.name: Group Project
items.trigger: Repair the same generator with other survivors
items.levelValues: 3/5/7% repair speed per survivor on the same generator
items.cooldownOrLimit: Does not stack with itself from multiple users
items.effectSummary: Boosts generator repair speed for grouped survivors and shares the effect.
items.cardSummary: Group Project rewards teaming on the same generator. It can push an objective faster, but duplicate users do not stack the perk.
items.rawEffect: Gain a 3/5/7% repair speed per survivor on the same generator as you. This effect is shared to every other survivor repairing the generator. Does not stack with itself if two or more survivors are using it.

items.name: High Karma
items.trigger: After you unspike another survivor
items.effectSummary: After rescuing someone, lets you self-unspike once later but applies anti-heal afterward.
items.cardSummary: High Karma rewards making the first rescue. It can save you later, but the anti-heal drawback means the self-save is not a free full reset.
items.rawEffect: After unspiking a survivor, this perk activates, allowing you to successfully unspike yourself the first time you get spiked. Unspiking yourself with this perk applies the anti heal status effect for 90/75/60 seconds.

items.name: Intense Workout
items.trigger: Unspike a survivor
items.levelValues: 40/45/50% faster unspike; 10% speed boost for 8 seconds
items.effectSummary: Speeds up unspiking and gives the rescued survivor a short speed boost.
items.cardSummary: Intense Workout is a rescue tempo perk. It makes the unspike faster and helps the saved survivor move away before pressure returns.
items.rawEffect: Whenever you unspike a survivor, you do it 40/45/50% faster and give them a 10% speed boost for 8 seconds.

items.name: Iron Tranquility
items.trigger: While on the spike
items.levelValues: Blood pool lifetime reduced by 3/4/5 seconds
items.effectSummary: Hides your aura while spiked and shortens the lifetime of your blood pools.
items.cardSummary: Iron Tranquility makes you harder to track while spiked. It is defensive value for players who expect the killer to camp information around rescue states.
items.rawEffect: Whilst on the spike, your aura is hidden from the killer. Additionally, this perk decreases the lifetime of your blood pools by 3/4/5 seconds.

items.name: No Pain No Gain
items.trigger: Always active with permanent injury
items.effectSummary: Trades permanent injury for self-recovery, no blood pools, and faster recovery speed.
items.cardSummary: No Pain No Gain is a risky self-recovery perk. It removes blood pools and lets you recover yourself, but permanent injury makes every chase more dangerous.
items.rawEffect: Become permanently injured and gain the ability to self recover from the dying state. This perk additionally stops the creation of blood pools and provides a 20/25/30% self recovery speed boost.

items.name: On Screen Fear
items.trigger: Inside terror radius but not in chase
items.effectSummary: Gives small movement and action boosts while near the killer but not being chased.
items.cardSummary: On Screen Fear rewards staying productive near danger. It is useful when the killer is close, but it drops in value once you are actually in chase.
items.rawEffect: Whenever you are in the terror radius of the killer and not in chase, gain a 1/2/3% movement speed boost and a 5/8/10% boost to healing and repairing.

items.name: Partners In Crime
items.trigger: Two survivors stay in terror radius for 15 seconds while not in chase
items.levelValues: Up to 3 tokens; 2/3/4% repair speed per token
items.cooldownOrLimit: Lose a token every 25 seconds while not repairing and lose one when entering chase
items.effectSummary: Builds repair-speed tokens with a nearby teammate inside terror radius, then loses tokens when pressure changes.
items.cardSummary: Partners In Crime is a duo objective perk. It rewards staying calm near the killer, but chase pressure or time away from repairs burns the tokens down.
items.rawEffect: When you and another survivor are both in the killer's terror radius for 15 seconds but not in chase, gain one token, up to 3. For every token you have, you gain a 2/3/4% repair speed bonus. You lose one token every 25 seconds while not repairing a generator, and you lose 1 token upon entering chase.

items.name: Second Wind
items.trigger: After you are unspiked
items.effectSummary: Extends Endurance after another survivor unspikes you.
items.cardSummary: Second Wind helps after a rescue, especially against repeat pressure. It does not prevent the spike, but it gives more time to escape after the save.
items.rawEffect: After you are unspiked, increase the duration of the endurance status effect by 15/20/25 seconds.

items.name: All Seeing Eye
items.trigger: Two survivors work one generator for 5 seconds
items.statusEffect: Loud noise notification; generator aura reveal
items.effectSummary: Alerts the killer and reveals the generator when two survivors stack on it.
items.cardSummary: All Seeing Eye punishes grouped objective pressure. It helps the killer notice when survivors are rushing the same generator.
items.rawEffect: If a generator is being worked on by 2 survivors at the same time for 5 seconds, it triggers a loud noise notification for the killer, and the aura of that generator is revealed for 3 seconds. This perk has a cooldown of 60/50/40 seconds.

items.name: Eyes of Hell
items.trigger: Survivor performs a vault
items.effectSummary: Shows loop structures and slows survivors briefly after they vault.
items.cardSummary: Eyes of Hell helps killers read loop routes before survivors use them. It is strongest against window-heavy chases and pallet paths.
items.rawEffect: You see the aura of all pallets, dropped pallets and vault locations within 80/90/100 studs. Whenever a survivor performs a vault, they suffer from 4% slowness for 5 seconds. This perk has a cooldown of 60/50/40 seconds.

items.name: King's Scourge
items.trigger: A generator reaches 90% progress once
items.levelValues: 9/12/15 special skill checks; 5/10/15 seconds repair penalty on failed check
items.statusEffect: Loud sound; generator pause; Vulnerable; regression
items.effectSummary: Turns near-finished generators into a skill-check trap with regression and survivor punishment on failure.
items.cardSummary: King's Scourge is heavy generator pressure. It is best when survivors are close to finishing objectives and one failed check can swing the repair back.
items.rawEffect: Once per generator, generators that reach 90% progress have their aura revealed and play a loud sound notification. Survivors repairing affected generators receive 9/12/15 special skill checks. Generator repair progress is paused until all skill checks are hit. If a special skill check is failed, survivors repairing become vulnerable and have 10% decreased repair speed for 5/10/15 seconds, the generator loses 15 charges, and regresses at double the normal rate.

items.name: Trade Off
items.trigger: Trial start and survivor saves from normal spikes
items.levelValues: Highest-progress generator aura reveal for 4/8/12 seconds
items.statusEffect: Cursed spike aura; generator aura reveal
items.effectSummary: Creates cursed spikes and reveals high-progress generator information when survivors interact with spike states.
items.cardSummary: Trade Off turns rescue pressure into map information. It helps killers connect spike saves to generator patrol decisions.
items.rawEffect: At the start of the trial, 2 random spikes are transformed into cursed spikes. Spikes affected by this perk are revealed to you through their aura. Whenever a survivor is saved from a normal spike, that spike becomes a cursed spike. Whenever a survivor is placed onto a cursed spike, the aura of the generator with the highest progress is revealed for 4/8/12 seconds.

items.name: Deep Wound
items.trigger: Survivor is unspiked from a cursed spike
items.effectSummary: Spawns cursed spikes that punish rescues with anti-heal and more blood pools.
items.cardSummary: Deep Wound makes cursed spike saves hurt more. It is pressure for killers who want rescues to create a healing problem afterward.
items.rawEffect: 3 Cursed spikes spawn on the map. Whenever a survivor is unspiked from a cursed spike, they gain the anti heal status effect for 20/30/40 seconds and leave blood pools 100% more frequently.

items.name: Exposure Therapy
items.trigger: Damage survivors, then survivors finish a heal in terror radius
items.levelValues: 3/4/5 extra seconds of Vulnerable per token consumed
items.cooldownOrLimit: 30 second cooldown; up to 8 tokens; consumes up to 4 tokens
items.effectSummary: Builds damage tokens, then punishes healing inside terror radius with Vulnerable and aura reveal.
items.cardSummary: Exposure Therapy is for killers who keep survivors injured and nearby. It makes rushed healing inside terror radius much riskier.
items.rawEffect: Damaging a survivor by any means grants you a token, up to a maximum of 8. Whenever a survivor finishes healing another survivor inside your terror radius, both survivors gain the vulnerable status effect for 10 seconds, as well as an additional 3/4/5 seconds of vulnerable and 1 second of aura reveal per token consumed, up to a maximum of 4. This perk has a cooldown of 30 seconds.

items.name: Murderous Acrobatics
items.trigger: Vault a window in chase once every 60 seconds
items.effectSummary: Lets the killer vault faster in chase and gain a short haste boost afterward.
items.cardSummary: Murderous Acrobatics gives killers a chase tool around windows. It helps when a survivor expects the vault to buy more time than it actually does.
items.rawEffect: Once every 60 seconds, while in a chase, you vault windows 30% faster. After vaulting this way, you gain a 3%/4%/5% haste status effect for 4 seconds.

items.name: Stage Fright
items.trigger: Your aura is revealed to a survivor
items.levelValues: 5/6/7% speed boost for the reveal duration
items.effectSummary: Turns survivor aura reveals into a speed boost for the killer.
items.cardSummary: Stage Fright punishes information perks and items that reveal the killer. It can turn a survivor read into a faster chase if the reveal lasts long enough.
items.rawEffect: Whenever your aura is revealed to a survivor, you gain a 5/6/7% speed boost for the duration of the reveal.

items.name: Containment
items.trigger: Killer vaults a window
items.cooldownOrLimit: Blocks the window for 16 seconds; killer can still vault it
items.effectSummary: Speeds up killer vaults and blocks the window for survivors after vaulting.
items.cardSummary: Containment is a route-control perk. It helps close off a window after the killer uses it, forcing survivors to find another path.
items.rawEffect: Whenever you vault a window, you vault 5/10/15% faster and block the window for 16 seconds. You can still vault the blocked window while it is blocked.

items.name: Touch Of Death
items.trigger: Killer vaults a window to apply Touch of Death
items.cooldownOrLimit: Up to 2 affected windows at the same time
items.statusEffect: Vulnerable; aura reveal; faster killer vault on affected windows
items.effectSummary: Marks up to two windows. Survivors who vault a marked window become Vulnerable and briefly reveal aura.
items.cardSummary: Touch Of Death makes chosen windows dangerous for survivors. It rewards killers who know which routes survivors are likely to use next.
items.rawEffect: Vaulting a window applies touch of death to it. You can see its aura in white, and you vault affected windows 20% faster. You can have up to 2 affected windows at the same time. When a survivor vaults a touch of death window, they suffer from the vulnerable status effect for 15/20/25 seconds, and their aura is revealed for 2 seconds. The effect is then removed from the window.
